name: Firestone
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Firestone, CO 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Firestone, CO for 2026: Carbon Valley Holiday Festival, a library Nutcracker and the fire district Santa Run, dates checked.
lede: Firestone hosts its part of the Carbon Valley Holiday Festival at Miners Park, adds a Nutcracker performance at the library and sends Santa through its neighborhoods with the fire district.
celebrates: The Town of Firestone hosts the Carbon Valley Holiday Festival at Miners Park on Saturday, December 5, from noon to 4 pm, with a holiday market of local makers and artists, hot cocoa, free kids crafts, free photos with Santa and the movie Elf on an LED screen, according to the town. The festival is a collaboration with Frederick and Dacono. The same afternoon, the Carbon Valley Regional Library hosts Centennial State Ballet's Nutcracker excerpts, and the Frederick-Firestone Fire District's Santa Run visits Firestone neighborhoods on December 19 and 20.
lastyear: The 2025 Carbon Valley Holiday Festival was held on Saturday, December 6, 2025, from noon to 4 pm, according to a listing of the town's event, with a holiday market, hot cocoa, holiday music, free crafts and photos with Santa. The Frederick-Firestone Fire District posted its 21st annual Santa Run for December 19, 20 and 21 last season, with routes beginning at 5 pm. This year the Firestone portion again runs from noon to 4 pm at Miners Park.
facts: Miners Park, at 170 Grant Avenue, is the home of Firestone's holiday festival. The Carbon Valley Regional Library, at 7 Park Avenue, serves as the regional library for the southwest area of High Plains Library District. Firestone also hosts Carbon Valley Kids Day in June, a free family event with live music, bounce houses and food trucks, and its programs list includes the Carbon Valley Santa Cops holiday program.
trains: Neither Frederick nor Firestone has a holiday train we could verify for 2026. The nearest holiday rail outing in our guides is the Polar Express Train Ride at the Colorado Railroad Museum in Golden, which runs November 6 to December 23, 2026, according to our event listing. The Colorado Model Railroad Museum in Greeley is a year-round alternative; our museum guide lists adult tickets at $15 and closed days on Tuesday and Wednesday.

faq: The Town of Firestone hosts the Carbon Valley Holiday Festival at Miners Park on December 5, 2026, from noon to 4 pm, with a holiday market, hot cocoa, free kids crafts, free Santa photos and the movie Elf. The fire district's Santa Run follows on December 19 and 20.
Is the Firestone holiday festival free?

The Town of Firestone says the kids crafts, the photos with Santa and the hot cocoa are free. The market features local makers and artists, so bring spending money if you want to shop. The festival runs from noon to 4 pm at Miners Park, 170 Grant Avenue, on Saturday, December 5, 2026.
What time is Elf playing at the Firestone festival?

The town lists showings of the holiday classic Elf on an LED screen at 12:15 pm and 2 pm on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at Miners Park. The town describes the movie as a break between browsing the market, crafts and cocoa, and the whole festival runs from noon to 4 pm.
Does Santa come to Firestone neighborhoods?

Yes. The Frederick-Firestone Fire District's 22nd annual Santa Run visits neighborhoods on December 19, 20 and 21, 2026, with routes beginning at about 5 pm. Sunday's routes include Old Town Firestone, and the district posts route maps and a live tracker.
Is there a Nutcracker near Firestone?

Yes. Centennial State Ballet performs excerpts from the Nutcracker at the Carbon Valley Regional Library on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 3 to 4 pm. The library's event page does not print a price. Families can pair it with the holiday festival at Miners Park, which runs noon to 4 pm that day.
Is there a holiday train near Firestone?

Not in town that we could verify. The closest is the Polar Express Train Ride at the Colorado Railroad Museum in Golden, which runs November 6 to December 23, 2026. The Colorado Model Railroad Museum in Greeley is another option, with adult tickets listed at $15.
